description: This file implements the main application delegate and app structure for an iOS app using SwiftUI, handling notifications, background tasks, and app lifecycle events. It manages remote notifications, background wake refreshes, and interaction with watch prompts, indicating it is a core component of the app's entry point and notification handling.

classes.name: OpenClawAppDelegate
classes.description: Main application delegate handling app lifecycle events, notifications, background tasks, and communication with the app model.

methods.name: application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)
methods.description: Initializes background tasks, sets notification delegate, and registers for remote notifications during app launch.

methods.name: application(_:didRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithDeviceToken:)
methods.description: Handles successful registration for remote notifications and forwards device token to app model.

methods.name: application(_:didFailToRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithError:)
methods.description: Logs errors if remote notification registration fails.

methods.name: application(_:didReceiveRemoteNotification:fetchCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles incoming silent push notifications and triggers background wake logic.

methods.name: scenePhaseChanged(_:)
methods.description: Schedules background refresh when the scene enters the background.

methods.name: registerBackgroundWakeRefreshTask()
methods.description: Registers the background wake refresh task with the system.

methods.name: scheduleBackgroundWakeRefresh(afterSeconds:reason:)
methods.description: Schedules a background task to refresh app state.

methods.name: handleBackgroundWakeRefresh(task:)
methods.description: Performs background refresh logic when wake refresh task runs.

methods.name: userNotificationCenter(_:willPresent:withCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles presentation of incoming notifications, showing banners for watch prompts.

methods.name: userNotificationCenter(_:didReceive:withCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles user responses to notifications, routing watch prompt actions accordingly.

methods.name: parseWatchPromptAction(from:)
methods.description: Extracts the watch prompt action details from a notification response.

methods.name: routeWatchPromptAction(_:)
methods.description: Routes the parsed watch prompt action to the app model for handling.
